final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, t.tradekind AS tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS avgc FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord r ON r.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = s.trdref2 GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avgc) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.transref AS transref, s1.tradekind AS tradekind, s1.avgc AS avgc, s1.avgc - s2.m AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.avgc > s2.m), s4 AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(avgc) AS a3, AVG(diff) AS a4 FROM s3 GROUP BY tradekind), s5 AS (SELECT AVG(a3) AS m5 FROM s4) SELECT s4.tradekind, s4.a3, s4.a4, s4.a3 / NULLIF(s5.m5, 0) AS ratio FROM s4 JOIN s5 ON s5.m5 IS NOT NULL
